description: This file defines the HeliconeLogger class responsible for logging events to Helicone, including methods for mapping responses, adding metadata from headers, and logging success events. It interacts with external services and handles different model types such as GPT and Claude.

classes.name: HeliconeLogger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging events to Helicone, including response mapping, metadata handling, and success logging.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HeliconeLogger instance with API URLs and keys.

methods.name: claude_mapping
methods.description: Maps Claude model responses into a standardized format, processing messages and tool calls.

methods.name: add_metadata_from_header
methods.description: Adds Helicone-related metadata from proxy request headers to the logging metadata.

methods.name: log_success
methods.description: Logs a successful response event to Helicone, including timing, model, and message details.
